verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents loading custom tools through MCP servers. The docs say it can integrate "custom business tools" and connect to any tool that provides an MCP server. Servers are declared in librechat.yaml or added at runtime from the MCP Settings panel without restarting, on a self-hosted local install. The tools library also exposes Actions and Skills, and a dedicated Skills docs page exists. Missing for 10: any evidence of the Skills or Actions authoring format (only the Skills page title is present), a LibreChat-specific guide to writing a custom tool, and hands-on corroboration of building and loading one locally.
